name: Identify Spacecraft Architecture & Subsystems
description: Adversary gathers intelligence on spacecraft bus, payload capabilities, flight software, and telemetry downlink frequencies.

name: Compromise Ground Station Segment
description: Adversary achieves initial access to satellite ground station control servers, tracking networks, or operator workstations.

name: Command Injection via Telemetry Bus
description: Adversary injects unauthorized command sequences into the flight computer or telemetry bus over compromised ground station relays.

name: Rogue Command Uplink & Telemetry Hijacking
description: Adversary transmits forged telemetry or uplink control frames across the radio frequency (RF) satellite link.

name: Ground-to-Space Lateral Movement
description: Adversary leverages compromised ground segment terminal to pivot into space-ground communications links and spacecraft bus controllers.

name: RF Downlink Jamming & Signal Degradation
description: Adversary transmits high-power interference on downlink frequencies to degrade or disrupt mission telemetry reception.
